newsitem.title: USA: Vastar bids on 47 tracts in Gulf of Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Vastar bids on 47 tracts in Gulf of Mexico.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said on Thursday that it was the apparent successful bidder, solely or with others, on 47 tracts in the March 5, 1997, Outer Continental Shelf (OCS), Central Gulf of Mexico Oil and Gas Lease Sale 166.
If all the tracts are awarded, Vastar will purchase almost 200,000 net acres at a cost of approximately $58 million, the company said.

Vastar's total of high bids for 19 tracts in shelf water (less than 200 meters) was approximately $21 million, the company said. For the remaining 28 tracts in deepwater, the net high bids were approximately $37 million, Vastar said.
Vastar's apparent successful bids include eight of its top 10 prospects on the shelf and all or a position on eight of its top 10 prospects in deepwater, Vastar said.
All bids are subject to review by the Minerals Management Service of the United States Department of the Interior, which managed the sale, Vastar said.
